name: Rise | 750mg Tincture | CBN
description: This CBN-only formulation helps to provide a non-euphoric experience of clarifying relaxation, mood-boosting, and improved gut health in a convenient tincture form. 750mg CBN per bottle and is THC free.? Each dropper is metered to allow for accurate dosing every single time. RISE CBN tincture does not contain any nut oil, is made with hemp seed oil (refined/golden) to offer a 100% cannabis-based tincture.
